## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2013-08-26: S-1 attaches form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.3
- 2013-09-25: TRA dated and effective immediately prior to October 1, 2013 IPO close
- 2013-10-07: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the IPO 8-K

#### Up-C collapse and TRA acceleration

- 2020-08-11: 8-K announces August 2020 Restructuring; Unit Exchange and Tax Receivable Acceleration Agreement filed as Exhibit 10.1 (form-of); reverse triangular merger collapses dual-class structure; Premier elects Section 4 early termination at $472.6M aggregate Early Termination Payment
- 2020-09: ~$10.6M lump-sum paid to non-electing LPs (within three business days of finalization)

#### Installment payment runoff

- 2021-Q1 through 2025-Q4 (fiscal): ~$462.9M paid via 18 equal quarterly installments under the Unit Exchange Agreements; final installment in the quarter ending June 30, 2025

## Explanation

Premier, Inc. became the TRA obligor on September 25, 2013, with effect at the October 1, 2013 Up-C IPO close; the beneficiaries were the approximately 180 member-owner hospital systems that held Class B Common Units in Premier LP. The TRA paid each Limited Partner 85% of the cash tax savings Premier realized from Section 754 basis step-ups arising from the Original Sale and from future exchanges of Class B Common Units. No amendments were filed during the contract's life. On August 11, 2020 Premier executed a Unit Exchange and Tax Receivable Acceleration Agreement concurrent with a reverse triangular merger that collapsed the dual-class structure, electing Section 4 early termination at an aggregate Early Termination Payment of approximately $472.6M; member-owners holding more than 99% of administrative-fee weight elected to receive their portion in 18 equal quarterly installments running through the fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2025, while non-electing LPs received their share (~$10.6M aggregate) in a lump sum in September 2020. The 18-quarter runoff has now completed; the TRA itself was extinguished at the August 2020 close, and subsequent quarterly payments were obligations of Premier outside the TRA contract. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
